people.name: Yashar Aryanfar
bio: Yashar Aryanfar earned his PhD in Advanced Engineering Sciences from the Autonomous University of Ciudad Juarez (UACJ) in Mexico. He is currently a postdoctoral researcher at National Cheng Kung University (NCKU) in Taiwan. His research spans a broad range of energy and environmental fields, including renewable energy, 4E (energy, exergy, economic, and environmental) analysis, advanced exergy analysis, geothermal systems, environmental engineering, and energy systems.
education: Ph.D., Advanced Engineering Sciences, Autonomous University of Ciudad Juarez (UACJ), Mexico

people.name: Hafiz Muhammad Irfan
bio: I am currently a Ph.D. candidate at the NCKU (Taiwan), Department of Chemical Engineering. My research interests include process system engineering, which integrates principles from chemical engineering, applied mathematics, computer science, and other related disciplines to design, analyze, optimize, and control complex processes and systems.
